questions.background: Michigan will elect a U.S. senator in November 2026. The Democratic primary will determine the party’s nominee for that election.

Resolution Date : Resolve when the winner of the primary, scheduled for August 4, 2026, is publicly established. Accepted Answer Format : The winning candidate’s name.

With 4 days left until August 4, no countering Stevens primary poll has emerged (Stevens instead touted a July 25 general-election matchup poll vs. Mike Rogers), and viral anti-Arab remarks by a Stevens supporter at a Stevens event added late negative coverage. Lifting Abdul El-Sayed 0.83 -> 0.91 and cutting Haley Stevens 0.17 -> 0.09—staying below Kalshi's 96.6% to preserve a realistic 9% upset buffer for older/absentee turnout composition (Emerson still has 60+ voters breaking 53%-39% for Stevens), massive pro-Stevens outside spending, and the mid-July Glengariff outlier.

questions.background: Andy Ogles has represented Tennessee’s 5th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives since 2023.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official Tennessee election results, with a definitive Associated Press race call accepted before certification. Resolution Event : The determination of the winner of the Republican primary for Tennessee’s 5th Congressional District scheduled for August 6, 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The winning candidate’s full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Fresh July 31 local reporting (TriStar Daily, Nashville Banner) strengthens the case for a near-tossup heading into Thursday's Aug 6 primary. Invest in Tomorrow Coalition shared cross-tabs of a larger N=1,046 likely GOP primary voter poll (MOE +/-3.3%) showing an even tighter initial dead heat—Andy Ogles 33.0% vs Charlie Hatcher 31.5% (35.5% undecided)—with Hatcher surging to a 44.9%-24.0% lead on the informed ballot as ITC deploys its $2.0M ad barrage (vs ~$500K-$666K for Freedom Caucus Fund). Early voting concluded Saturday Aug 1 across the drastically redrawn, Nashville-free rural/agricultural TN-5 map, and local analysts note Ogles' hurried July 28 Trump tele-rally may have had limited reach given Ogles' weak cash position ($58K vs Hatcher's $105K). Still keeping Ogles a modest favorite given Trump's endorsement in a Trump +23 seat, incumbency, PAC-poll lean, and his 2024 primary survival, trimming Andy Ogles 0.62 -> 0.56 and lifting Charlie Hatcher 0.38 -> 0.44.

questions.title: What source of cocaine exposure will UK Anti-Doping cite when publicly explaining the resolution of Joseph Parker's October 2025 doping case?

questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : UK Anti-Doping's official decision or public statement explaining the resolution of Parker's case arising from the cocaine tests associated with his October 2025 bout. There was contamination,' confirmed the defense submitted 'witness statements,' and remarked 'all we are waiting for is a yes, OK then accept it, there's your ban' (hoping to fight again in 2-3 months). Attributing contamination to 'the people around him at the time' backed by witness statements shifts probability sharply away from factory-contaminated supplements (rare for cocaine and reliant on batch testing rather than witness statements) and toward bystander/interpersonal exposure routes.
